# ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview (280B-A14B)

Baidu · released 2026-11

Baidu release post dated November 11, 2026: the first post-trained model built on ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base; API model ernie-5.5-flash-preview on Qianfan. Baidu says 'the weights will be open-sourced under Apache 2.0 soon'; no public repository existed on 2026-11-14, so it is recorded as closed until the weights are published. Qianfan lists its price only in CNY, so no USD price is recorded; the 1M-token context is stated in the post but not recorded because the post is not a reviewed context source. ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, the pretrain-only checkpoint, is a different artifact and is not in the catalogue.

[Catalogue source](https://ernie.baidu.com/release/ernie-5-5-flash-preview/)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.
